text: Hey, how are you?
zh: 嘿，你好吗？

text: Can I help you?
zh: 有什么能帮你的吗？

text: What are you doing here?
zh: 你在这儿做什么？

text: What are you doing with these boxes?
zh: 你搬这些箱子做什么？

text: Are you a member of the royal guard?
zh: 你是皇家卫队的成员吗？

text: You sold fake wine to Baron Frestek.
zh: 你把假酒卖给了弗雷斯泰克男爵。

text: What do you know about Cedric's stolen list?
zh: 关于塞德里克被偷的清单，你知道些什么？

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: I'm helping the quartermaster with these crates.
zh: 我在帮军需官搬这些货箱。

text: Sometimes I also take care of deliveries or errands for the guards or some citizens.
zh: 有时我也替卫兵或市民们送送货、跑跑腿。

text: Feel free to call me Marvin.
zh: 叫我马文就行。

text: The guard's crates and barrels are scattered all over the city.
zh: 卫队的货箱和木桶散落在城里各处。

text: I collect the empty boxes and carry them back into the basement of the barracks.
zh: 我负责收集空箱子，把它们搬回兵营的地下室。

text:
Not yet.
I'm only helping the quartermaster so that he can put in a good word for me with the king's advisor.
zh:
还不是。
我给军需官帮忙，只是想让他在国王的顾问面前替我美言几句。

text: The advisor Edmon is the only one to accept new members into the ranks of the guards.
zh: 只有顾问埃德蒙才有权接纳新人加入卫队。

text:
Huh?
I... I don't know...
zh:
啊？
我……我不知道……

text: Oh shit, I knew it wasn't going to end well.
zh: 糟了，我就知道这事不会有好下场。

text: Where do you get the wine from?
zh: 你的酒是从哪儿弄来的？

text: Why should I let you go?
zh: 我凭什么放你走？

text: I will hand you over to the Academy.
zh: 我要把你交给魔法学院。

text: Get out of here and leave the capital for good!
zh: 滚吧，永远别再回王都！

text:
Listen!
Let me go, and I'll promise to stop the fake wine deliveries.
zh:
听我说！
放我走，我保证再也不送假酒了。

text: I can't tell you.
zh: 我不能告诉你。

text: If it comes out who produces the fake wine, they'll hang me from the nearest pole.
zh: 要是让人知道假酒是谁造的，他们会就近找根杆子把我吊死。

text:
I've been able to put a lot of gold aside lately.
Let me run, and you'll get some.
zh:
我最近攒下了不少金币。
放我一马，分你一份。

text:
Thanks, man!
This gold here is yours.
zh:
多谢了，朋友！
这些金币是你的了。

text:
What? No!
But getting upset probably won't do any good.
zh:
什么？不要！
不过再闹下去恐怕也没什么用。

text: I deserve what comes next.
zh: 接下来的下场是我应得的。

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text:
Uhh...
Nothing, sir!
zh:
呃……
没什么，先生！

text:
Huh?
Yeah... I.. I was.
zh:
啊？
是……我、我参与了。

text: You were involved in the last wine deliveries.
zh: 你参与了最近几次送酒。

text: I found Cedric's list in the barracks cellar.
zh: 我在兵营地窖里找到了塞德里克的清单。
